We tried dal Batti churma , royal thal , mirchi Wada , moong dal bhaiya , bajra khichiyu, tea , uttapam, idli and everything was just sooo yummy ! Full gujju / Marwadi taste and very good on stomach. The staff is very friendly and nice too .

featured_reviews.name: Kristy Gala
featured_reviews.review_text:
This has to be the best pure veg and jain spot, serves amazing thali and even their breakfast menu is superb! We tried their :
Dhokla platter, sada dosa, idli meduvada, grill sandwich, everything jain and loved it🥰
And for lunch we tried their govindas royal thali unlimited for ₹449 only which has more than 15 items served in it, so good!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hey Kristy ji! 

We're thrilled to hear that you had an exceptional experience at Govinda's Thaal & Tea House!  Your review has made our day, and we're grateful for your kind words about our pure veg and Jain options. We're particularly delighted that you enjoyed our thali and breakfast menu - it's always a pleasure to serve our customers with a smile! 

We're also happy to hear that you loved our Dhokla platter, Sada Dosa, Idli Meduvada, and Grill Sandwich - we take pride in our Jain-friendly options, and it's great to know that they met your expectations! 

Regarding our Govinda's Royal Thali, we're thrilled that you found the value for money to be exceptional. We believe that a thali should be a complete meal experience, and we're glad that you enjoyed the variety of items we offered. ₹449 for an unlimited thali is indeed a great deal! 

Once again, thank you for your glowing review, Kristy ji! We're honored to have served you, and we look forward to welcoming you back to Govinda's Thaal & Tea House soon. 

Warm Regards,
Team Govinda's Thaal & Tea House

featured_reviews.name: Dhanashree Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text:
This newly opened authentic South Indian Cafe will surely melt your heart with its comforting food and cute ambience!
We tried their Podi Idli, Podi Masala Dosa and Neer Dosa. The quality and quantity is too good.
If you are a ghee lover, you will surely enjoy these dishes as the amount of ghee that goes in is too generous!  Even the filter kapi and Chai is just perfect.
The rates are too budget friendly and the food is worth every penny.
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: josepheena thomas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had been here today after my work as i had skipped lunch.. The place was very welcoming, the Uncle sitting on the counter was very cute, i asked him to recommend something light to me and he suggested Bene dosa..i had the bene dosa it was yummy, tummy and soul filling, i also ordered for the filter kaapi and i received it in an authentic South Indian style glass..Loved the experience and wanted to share this everyone..
Cheers to the staff and everyone for their outstanding job…Cheers ! Keep it up.

featured_reviews.name: Sheetalsplatestory
featured_reviews.review_text: Just a 2-minute stroll from Vasai station, this South Indian cafe is a must-visit! 🌟 We savored their newly launched benne dosa, garlic dosa, thatte idli, and authentic filter coffee. Delicious flavors and cozy vibes!

featured_reviews.name: Tanisha Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text: Masala dosa bohot ganda h . The aloo baji inside the dosa is spoiled(kharab hogya tha) they serve the dosa like that only. The baji was sour in taste. It will lead to food poisoning. So better pls don't eat. I told the staff, they changed the dosa but he told ki sub yahi kha rhe h he asked the chef but the chef told the baji is proper. Not only me even the aunty sitting next to me had same problem. Aunty vo khaya bhi nh. Then too vo log vahi sabji use kr rhe the khaneme.

featured_reviews.name: Adv Surabhi Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was craving for milkshake and decided to try milkbar. It was my first time from their outlet.

I had -
Mint Oreo Milkshake - Perfect in taste. Good mixture of mint and oreo flavour. Quantity was good.

Mixed Berries Smoothie Milkshake - This was totally worth. Loved the taste of this. If you love berries then go for it.

Quantity of the milkshake was good. They serve good range of shakes. Service is super quick. And rates are cheap compared to the milkshakes.

I’m sure I’ll order from here again!
Highly recommended.
